page.layout: One page with a table-like block of verb forms at upper right, in three columns of short lines. A vertical strip of rotated fragments runs down the left edge beside a decorative floral border. A woodcut initial stands in the middle left. Lower part of the page shows mirrored show-through, which is left out.
page.notes: The upper right block is printed in a heavy, partly smudged type; the word endings at the left of each line are cut off by the overlapping left strip, so the first words of lines 1 to 4 are illegible. The left strip is printed sideways and only partly readable; its items are given as read, with doubtful letters unmarked but uncertain. Lower-middle and lower-right text is mirrored show-through from the reverse side (for example "redde", "Aendo", "mitgeo", "-erstatt") and is not transcribed. The woodcut initial and the floral border are decoration. No page number or running head is visible.
